titre: Primes nouvelles de l'assurance vie individuelle aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Milliards de dollars de primes nouvelles annualisées, par trimestre en 2025

T1 2025.texte: U.S. individual life insurance new annualized premium improved 8% year over year to $3.94 billion in the first quarter

T2 2025.texte: Total new annualized premium increased 13% to $4.5 billion in the second quarter

T3 2025.texte: Total new annualized premium increased 14% year over year to $4.3 billion in the third quarter

T4 2025.texte: In the fourth quarter of 2025, new annualized premium totaled $4.9 billion, up 6% over the prior year.
